title: Alessandro Manzoni's birth chart
metaDescription: Alessandro Manzoni's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 17.3° Pisces. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the nine placements whose signs are settled, fixed leads with four. Fixed weight is read as endurance, with the same machinery producing both loyalty and stubbornness.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Pisces, but precisely: 17.3°, second decan, 10°–20°, under the Moon in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Mercury holds 25.4° Aquarius, Venus holds 2.9° Taurus, Mars holds 28.0° Capricorn — in the old shorthand, a mind at home in argument and pattern; taste for the substantial and the lasting; drive that grinds rather than flares.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Venus at right angles from Saturn, 1.0° off exact. A square is friction that produces motion — the aspect the tradition credits with building capability precisely by refusing to be comfortable. Behind it, Uranus square Neptune at 1.5°, and Neptune trine Pluto at 1.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Mercury stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Four planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. Venus in Taurus at 2.9° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Capricorn at 28.0° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Pisces at 19.9° is in domicile; Saturn in Aquarius at 1.9° is in domicile. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements air 4, water 3, earth 2; modalities fixed 4, cardinal 3, mutable 2. Air weights a chart toward language and pattern — the impulse to name a thing before deciding how to feel about it. No settled placement falls in fire — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Uranus and Neptune were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Capricorn into Aquarius during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.4° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
